param.label: Minimum Mapping Quality
param.help: Discard reads with mapping quality below this threshold.

param.label: Minimum Base Quality
param.help: Discard bases with quality below this threshold.

param.label: Trim bases
param.help: Number of bases to discard at both ends of the reads.

param.label: Region
param.help: Target region for analysis (specify as CHROM:START-END). Leave blank for whole genome.

validator.message: Region format must be like 'chr' or 'chr:start-end'

param.label: Minimum Individuals
param.help: Only keep sites with data from at least this many individuals.

param.label: Minimum Total Depth
param.help: Discard site if total sequencing depth is below this value. (-1 indicates no filtering)

param.label: Maximum Total Depth
param.help: Discard site if total sequencing depth is above this value. (-1 indicates no filtering)

param.label: Minimum Depth per Individual
param.help: Discard individual if sequencing depth is below this value. (-1 indicates no filtering)

param.label: Maximum Depth per Individual
param.help: Discard individual if sequencing depth is above this value. (-1 indicates no filtering)
